ui.origins_familiarity.form.title: Your Bound Familiar
ui.origins_familiarity.form.subtitle: A familiar is bound to your soul. What shape will it take?
Walks at your side. Fights up close as a melee spellcaster, or casts from range with a staff.
ui.origins_familiarity.form.flying.desc: Hovers around you. Strikes and retreats as a skirmisher, or casts from the air with a staff.
